cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Interesting. The picnic moved from Saturday to Friday. Whose blue pen is that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And whose handwriting adds hearts to Fridays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now, who should tell the Saturday guests?
